findings.evidence: ClassSum.lean lines 26–28 require `[Semiring k] [Nontrivial k]`, whereas CharacterTheory/Suggested.lean lines 75–77 pins `[Semiring k]` and README.md lines 206–207 explicitly requires computability under that signature. The explicit support equals the nonzero coefficient support only because `1 ≠ 0`; without that assumption, deciding whether the support is the class or empty requires coefficient-side decidability absent from the pinned API.
findings.fix: Resolve the prerequisite first: either provide a computable construction for all semirings or amend the roadmap API to require enough decidability/nontriviality, then align these declarations with it.
findings.issue: The section-wide `[Nontrivial k]` makes `classSum`, `classSum_eq_sum`, and `classSum_commutes_of` unavailable for arbitrary semirings, while the targeted signature requires only `[Semiring k]`; the center theorem is narrowed likewise.

summary: The implementation obtains computability by narrowing the pinned coefficient generality, so it still does not faithfully implement the roadmap target.
